messages:
Ethan: heads up — new user on React Native quickstart sees auth retries + app crash on first call. They followed README exactly.
Priya: crash? what's the error in logs?
Ethan: RN logs show repeated 401s then a final 200 and the app throws because the streaming emitter never attached. Sample output: 'AuthError: 401' repeated 3x, then 'Request complete: 200' and RN UI shows empty chat.
June (devex): interesting — 401 retries then 200. any billing state?
Ethan: workspace is 'trial_pending' per console; user said they ignored billing banner. They created API key via web console before activating billing.
BillingBot: Note: API keys created prior to billing activation are limited. Streaming is disabled until billing activation. The gateway can return intermediate 401/403 for auth edge cases, and then a short 200 body to indicate throttled non-stream. See docs.
Aria (sdk): RN SDK behavior: we retry on 401 once for token refresh scenarios, then if response switches to 200 (non-chunked) our stream binding resolves empty and UI code doesn't handle that case. Also RN ios cancels fetch if app backgrounded which sometimes causes the emitter to never fire.
Priya: We need to address two things: 1) server should not return ambiguous 200 after auth failures, 2) SDK should surface billing-specific error clearly and avoid retry loops for billing-related 401/403.
June (devex): Agreed. Proposals: backend return structured JSON with code 'billing_inactive' and status 402 for API/stream gating; also include header X-Redwood-Error: billing_inactive for easy detection.
Aria (sdk): SDK changes: detect X-Redwood-Error or 402 and throw BillingInactiveError before trying to upgrade to stream. Stop treating 401/403 as auto-retry when response contains billing metadata. Also RN SDK should add an explicit check in quickstart: call GET /v1/workspace or validate key before opening stream.
Ethan: For now I told the user to activate trial and re-create the key. They said restarting app after enabling billing fixed it. But this is a terrible first impression.
Priya: Also add server-side fix for keys created pre-activation: they should be flagged and get immediate clear JSON errors for API calls. No HTML.
June (devex): UX change: quickstart wizard should detect 'trial_pending' and block streaming sample with a one-click 'Activate trial' CTA. Make the quickstart README clearer about SA/key timing.
Aria (sdk): I'll add heuristics: if response has content-length < 1024 and body JSON has 'billing' or header X-Redwood-Error=billing_inactive -> emit BillingInactiveError. Also make SDK non-fatal: surface friendly error message to dev console + link to console.
Support-bot: QA reproduce: created org via SSO, created key, ran RN quickstart -> saw the retry loop and empty UI. Created new key after enabling billing -> works.
Priya: Action items: 1) infra: return 402 + X-Redwood-Error for billing gating (priya -> infra), 2) sdk: stop auto-retries on billing auth signals, add BillingInactiveError + RN preflight (aria -> sdk), 3) devex: update quickstart wizard & README with billing preflight and CTA (june -> devex), 4) docs: add FAQ "Why did my quickstart crash with auth retries?" (support-bot -> docs).
Ethan: I'll attach user logs & Sentry event.
June (devex): Let's aim to land SDK patch this week and infra fix in next deploy window. Post an announcement once done.
Ethan: thanks all — I'll update thread when PRs land. :thumbsup:
